Package com.agrialert.ui.alerts

Class AlertUiModel

java.lang.Object
com.agrialert.ui.alerts.AlertUiModel
public class AlertUiModel extends Object
UI Model representing an alert item in a list. This model contains all the necessary data to display an alert's details, including its type, location, timing, and resolution status.

  • Field Details

    • id

      public long id
      The unique identifier of the alert.

    • typeId

      public String typeId
      The type identifier of the alert (e.g., "VENTO_FORTE", "ONDATA_CALORE"). Corresponds to one of the predefined alert categories.

    • title

      public String title
      The display title of the alert (e.g., "High Wind").

    • thresholdText

      public String thresholdText
      Descriptive text for the threshold that triggered the alert. Example: "Wind > 50 Km/h".

    • fieldAddress

      public String fieldAddress
      The address or location description of the affected field.

    • timeLabel

      public String timeLabel
      A human-readable label for when the alert is expected or occurred. Example: "Today", "Tomorrow", "In 5 days".

    • isResolved

      public boolean isResolved
      Indicates whether the alert has been marked as resolved by the user.

    • iconRes

      @DrawableRes public int iconRes
      The drawable resource ID for the icon representing the alert type.
